summary: Vote for Peace, which evaluates candidates on human rights and AIPAC/war-lobby funding, rated Amy Acton an "Ally" in the general phase of her Ohio gubernatorial race. That directional rating is the concrete evidence of her stance on Palestinian justice documented here. Her campaign platform addresses domestic priorities—economy, education, healthcare, criminal justice—and does not reference Israel or Palestine.
